about: CP-7: what the corpus recorder (scripts/corpus/record.mjs) and the corpus cells (packages/cli/src/corpus/corpus.test.ts) both read. The recorder applies it to what the published release wrote; the cells apply it to what the current store, importer, composer and loader produce, and to the recorded side, before comparing. A change here changes both sides at once.

work_placeholder.about: The recorder's WORK folder (and its realpath), wherever it appears in a recorded file's text, becomes this path; the cells replace the manifest's WORK the same way on the current side (the stored copy in realm.db keeps the raw path).

uuid.about: Every id minted by randomUUID: the run's id, gate ids, lease tokens, request_id, the WAL and sealed lines' nonce. Each distinct v4 UUID in an artifact's text becomes a fixed v4 UUID numbered by first appearance in that text (key order kept), so two places that held the same id still hold the same placeholder.

keys.about: Values replaced wherever the key appears: placeholders of the same shape the readers check (an integer for a process id, an ISO instant for a stamp, an absolute path for a path).

nested.about: A value that is volatile only under its parent key: a schema entry's source.path (a host path); an extension identity entry's captured_at (the host's clock, not the test clock) and pid.

runtime_only_workflow_keys.about: The keys the loader stamps on a definition that are not the workflow file's: left out of a recorded definition and of the current one. The names of core's RUNTIME_ONLY_WORKFLOW_KEYS (packages/core/src/types/workflow-definition.ts), which @sensigo/realm does not export.
